Preview:

WWE NXT 11/24/26 is set to deliver another exciting episode on November 24, with the developmental brand continuing its build towards the upcoming NXT TLC premium live event. With Grayson Waller reigning as NXT Champion, several superstars are looking to earn an opportunity to challenge him for the title.

Additionally, an eight-person tag team match will see Noam Dar, Romeo Moreno, Hank Walker, and Tank Ledger collide with The Vanity Project, who will have Myka Lockwood as their fourth member. This will be Lockwood’s in-ring debut on NXT programming. The upcoming episode will feature a number one contender’s match between Mason Rook and Shiloh Hill, with the winner securing a championship opportunity at TLC. Meanwhile, Zaria will defend her NXT Women’s North American Championship against Izzi Dame following their recent rivalry. Another big attraction will be the appearance of John Cena, who promised one final addition from NXT before kicking off the John Cena Classic tournament. This appearance was not originally planned in the schedule, but it seems that the 17-time champion is impressed with the available talent pool.

Every week, we have seen more and more stars recruited by John Cena for the upcoming John Cena Classic. Last week, Izzi Dame and Shiloh Hill were announced as the newest NXT competitors. Dame is even planning on entering the tournament with gold around her waist. Izzi Dame will compete in a championship match, and there will be a men’s No. 1 Contendership match. Who will be the competitors? And we can’t forget all the turmoil in the tag team division. A massive eight-person tag team match will take place, with a debuting competitor. Keep reading to find out who will be on WWE NXT this coming Tuesday. For weeks, Izzi Dame has been playing mind games with Zaria. She kept pestering Zaria about her past, specifically how she played Glinda in her school version of The Wizard of Oz. Dame recently defeated Zaria in a non-title match at Halloween Havoc. Dame requested that it be a non-title match, which shocked everyone.  She won in her Glinda-inspired gear, only to get even more into Zaria’s head. Below for complete match card and show detail for WWE Nxt November 24th, 2026 episode.

Match Card:

  • Eight Man Tag Team Match:Hank And Tank (Hank Walker & Tank Ledger), Noam Dar & Romeo Moreno vs. The Vanity Project (Brad Baylor, Jackson Drake, Myka Lockwood & Ricky Smokes)
  • WWE NXT Title #1 Contendership Match:Mason Rook vs. Shiloh Hill
  • WWE NXT Women’s North American Title Match:Zaria (c) vs. Izzi Dame

Location & Date:

  • Show: WWE NxT 11/24/26
  • Location: WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida.
  • Date & Time: Tuesday, November 24, 2026 | 8:00PM ET – 6:00AM PT
